headline: Leaf & brush pickup, Oct 30 – Nov 17
description:
Public Services collects properly bagged leaves and small piles of brush at the curb.
Leaves must be in biodegradable paper bags, no tape.
This service is not connected to trash collection and generally will not happen on the same day. Brush pickup is free during this program.

headline: City offices / library closed for Indigenous People's Day
description:
Westbrook City Hall, the Walker Memorial Library, and the Westbrook Community Center's Administrative Offices will be closed on October 12, 2026. Please note that the Westbrook Community Center facility will be open for public use and all classes and activities will continue, unless otherwise noted. 

Indigenous Peoples' Day is a holiday that honors the history, culture, and resilience of Native Americans and Alaska Natives. It is celebrated annually on the second Monday in October.

headline: Absentee Voting at City Hall: Oct 5-29
description: Westbrook residents may register to vote and/or request an absentee ballot in person at Westbrook City Hall beginning on Monday, October 5, 2026. Absentee voting at City Hall takes place during normal business hours through Thursday, October 29, 2026. All absentee ballots must be returned to Westbrook City Hall no later than 8pm on Election Day, November 3rd. Westbrook Elections Hotline: 207-591-8116.
